text:
maya: heads-up — the Edge sample on Vercel is failing after the latest publish: runtime error `Cannot find module "dist/index.cjs"`.

sam: which files were actually published?

publish-bot: published @redwood/inference-js@2.1.0 — assets: dist/index.mjs, dist/index.d.ts, package.json, README.md

maya: publish tarball has only .mjs + types. package.json still sets `main: "dist/index.cjs"` and `exports.require` points to .cjs, so some bundlers request CJS and it 404s.

lex: CI changed rollup to emit esm-only last week (PR 998). we omitted CJS build and sourcemaps (accidental `--no-sourcemap`).

dev-bot: pipeline: last known-good build with cjs+esm 1797980000. Rollup config modified by @ryan in PR 998.

aqil: plan: (1) republish 2.1.1 with both dist/index.cjs + dist/index.mjs and include .map files; (2) add prepublish verification script to fail if cjs/esm/types/maps missing; (3) add `npm pack` smoke-test in CI that installs the tarball into `examples/next-edge` and runs a minimal build; (4) update sample apps to use `import` for edge targets and add README guidance on bundler/Next/Edge import patterns.

sam: agreed. also update `exports` in package.json to use conditional exports for import/require and ensure `types` is correct.

maya: can someone open the CI PR? I'll hold off unpinning until patch is published and sample app verified. :thumbsup:
